items.title: Alvin Alcorn and Eddie Marrero Interview, 1979-12-04
items.q: All with Professor Robichaud. Robichaud, he used to play with Robichaud.

ctx.s: Alvin Alcorn (co-interviewee / Marrero family member, NOT interviewer)
ctx.x: Eddie, nobody's asking you, how did Lawrence influence you to play music? Didn't Lawrence the one that encouraged you? Yeah, yeah, he encouraged me. How did he do it?

I tell you, there was a bunch of boys around the same age. This little boy was coming up, he was a great connoisseur, they called him Bush Hall. Josiah Frazier was just learning drums. Still on his own show. Right. Still on his own show. What's up, about 16 years old. So they all got interested, so they made me into Lawrence, because he was the manager of the band. Lawrence managed every band he played in. All with Professor Robichaud. Robichaud, he used to play with Robichaud. And, uh, so we got together. Our…

Um, but you said you played mainly because your brothers played. Uh-uh. Was it because they wanted you to play, or did you admire them? I mean, you know, did they, did you admire them for playing music? Me?
